title: Chapter 582
paragraphs: Chapter 582
Episode 151. Situation Summary (2)
"-Who do you think are the other forces searching for Thamar's tomb?
-Who do you think?
-Ziphr.
-Correct! But that's not all. The Bimante royal family is also looking for the tomb of the first ruler of Runecandl. Your movements have been exposed to them once."
The conversation that Jin had with Marjiela when Kinzello came to Runecandl to invite Jin to join them.
It was then that Jin first learned that Bimante was searching for Thamar's tomb.

Unless one receives the blessing of the shadow, the legacies left in his tomb by Soldelet cannot be used. Moreover, all the legacies that have been revealed so far are those that Soldelet had already distributed a thousand years ago.
Therefore, while Ziphr needs to prevent Jin and Runecandl from using these legacies, Bimante doesn't really need to track Thamar's tomb.
At that time, Marjiela not only told Jin that Bimante was tracking Thamar's tomb, but also that they were looking for the 'body' and not the legacy.
Jin didn't know what they wanted to do with Thamar's body. However, after his experience with a mine in the Wontaramo forest, he speculated that it might be for mining.
This ominous and horrific speculation eventually turned out to be true.

"I'm not sure exactly when Bimante got Thamar Runecandl's body. It could be because it's too far back for my record magic to confirm, or because Ziphr's power, which is manipulating Thamar Runecandl's history, is too strong."
Valeria's speculation was accurate.

When she first obtained the mine corpse and used her record magic, almost all information was not visible. Due to Ziphr's manipulation magic, which is erasing 'Thamar Runecandl's history', even the location of the laboratory, which has no direct relation to Thamar, was not revealed.
However, thanks to Gliec, the situation changed as 'the power of the story' held by Ziphr dulled. Records that were not previously visible began to appear from the mine corpse.

However, the power of the story has not completely disappeared, and it was a thousand years ago when Bimante obtained 'some' of Thamar's flesh. Valeria's current ability cannot confirm up to that time.
"…I think they only used a part of the body, not the whole. If it was the whole, the mine would have been completed, and there would be no reason for Bimante to still be looking for his tomb."
Eureka!
Jin's eyes darkened at the bitter words.
'Those crazy bastards... weren't they afraid of the consequences? Or, did they decide it was better to complete the mine, even if it meant taking the risk of Runecandl finding out about it?'
Either way, it was infuriating for Jin.
'It seems that even Ziphr didn't know that the royal family had a part of Thamar's body until now, they must have been confident that they would never be exposed.'

It was something that Jin could never have discovered if it hadn't been for Valeria. The royal family was caught because they did not take into account the survivor of Hister and her relationship with Jin.
"Are you going to attack the royal family right away?"
Valeria asked in a nonchalant voice, but Jin could tell she was quite concerned about this issue.

It's been just over a month since the end of the sword emperor war and the Gliac subjugation. The moment Jin informs the family of the royal family's atrocities and strikes the empire, this land will face another disaster.
Valeria was worried about the countless ordinary people who would die for no reason. Jin found her concern, which he had not seen in a long time, both pleasing and regrettable.
'Jin Luncandel... You're looking deep inside me again.'
While Valeria was thinking, Jin shook his head.
"No, it's the land that Ron and Hyran fought so hard to protect. We can't plunge it back into a war zone immediately."
"Is that so?"

"Besides, it's not right for Luncandel to go to war now. It's impossible to attack the empire without a reason, so the family must publicize the information about Temar, which means that Zipol will know, and the family will have to deal with both the empire and Zipol."

Even if he wanted to tear apart and kill the entire royal family right now, the situation did not allow it. Even Dante had few ways to help Jin if Luncandel attacked the empire. The role of the sword emperor was to protect the empire.
"Now is the time for me and my people to monopolize the information and prevent the royal family from further insulting and violating Temar."
"That's a good choice."
"You know how to compliment?"

"Sometimes. I was worried. I thought you might be a fool who would share the information you worked hard to find with the family. If Luncandel knew this fact, matters concerning Temar's body would not be your concern but your family's, and I would have difficulty examining the record of the mine corpse."
"You weren't worried about innocent people dying in the war?"
Valeria did not answer, but took a sip of her tea.

"Anyway, a lot has changed because the King of Chaos has ended. Not only the mine corpse, but I am also beginning to see clues in deciphering the record devices of Soldrelet you gave me. And your Luncandel has regained some of the power of the magic sword."
"Yes. The curse Zipol placed on Luncandel is fading."
"The same goes for the curse passed down to my ancestors. There has been a slight change in the history of Hister that they erased."
Suddenly, Valeria stood up and bowed to Jin.
"I think I should thank you."
Jin barely managed to hide his surprise.
"I think you should be thanking Ron."
"I plan to do so before I leave, on my way near the territory of the sword emperor."
"You're talking like you're going right now."

"Anyway, you'll see me more frequently than before, so there's no need to feel regretful. We have more things to share and more things to help each other with. From now on, I plan to use Tikan frequently to avoid Ziphil's pursuit."
"I don't remember giving you permission, but you seem to have decided it already."
At those words, Valeria smiled. Ever since his previous life, Jin always felt happy when she smiled like that.

After the Sword Emperor's palace incident, there were always Rune Kandell's guardian knights in the vicinity of Tikan. Now, as Rune Kandell, they couldn't overlook what was happening in Tikan. For Jin, and for the family.

Excluding the inheritance land, there was no safer place for Valeria than Tikan now. Especially since Ziphil's pursuit has become more persistent recently, most of her hiding places have been exposed or destroyed.
"If you treat me as an unwelcome guest, I'll look elsewhere."
"Come often. Even when you have no business."
"I'll try."
"However, for a while, I won't be able to meet you from my side. Once I resolve a few matters, I plan to free up some time soon."
"Chaos. Is it because of that?"
At Valeria's response, Jin reflexively covered the back of his right hand.

On the back of that hand, there remained a black speck of chaos that he obtained from the abyss of Gliac. Even after it died, the traces of the chaos that had corroded Jin did not disappear completely.
It wasn't that the intense mana from that time was pressing on Jin's inner self, but he occasionally felt a slight demonic force.
And that demonic force was slowly growing. If left alone, it might become as large as what he experienced in Gliac's abyss.
He had already met with the Holy King Rani. If she couldn't cure the spots left on Jin's body, it meant there was currently no way.
However, Jin remembered that the divine blood left in his body was resisting the corrosion of chaos.
'The brothers of Rapralosa, especially the divine brothers, might know some way.'
Jin planned to find a way to stop the demonization in Rapralosa.

And it wasn't just Jin who fell into the corrosion of chaos. Rosa and Kelliac, including them, the same phenomenon was happening to some key figures of the two great families who participated in the Gliac subjugation battle.
While Jin was in Rapralosa, they would find a way to stop the demonization outside.

"It's part of it, but now is the right time. For training in the land of the brothers. I was originally going to go, but now that both great families are weakened and the family is actively starting to protect Tikan, I can go with a lighter heart."
Jin had already shared with Valeria about Rapralosa.
When they pull the brothers out of the dead world called Rapralosa as a reward later, her abilities would certainly be needed.
The punishment the clan of the Holy King is undergoing is also connected to Ziphil's historical manipulation.
"I'll also look for ways to heal your chaos."
"Thanks if you do that."
"But don't get your hopes up too high. Looking at the records about chaos is really hard. Oh, and before you leave, show me that thing you mentioned earlier."

The item Valeria was referring to was the unidentified mechanical device that Jin had obtained in the Sota Desert. Jin took out the mechanical device from his pocket and handed it to Valeria. A part of the spaceship blueprint was also included.
"Are you asking for the spaceship blueprint too? You're taking too much advantage."
"Is it too much to create a completed version of the blueprint with a record magic?"

"Record magic is not omnipotent. If the blueprint creator is present and his memory is incomplete to help in restoration, it's one thing. But it's impossible to figure out the whole from part of the blueprint just with record magic."
"Even if your record magic reaches a perfect level?"
"Maybe it would have been possible if our family was in its heyday."
A blue and transparent magic window appeared in front of Valeria. The magic emanating from her permeated the mechanical device and the blueprint, seeping out and engraving characters on the window.
While looking at the window where the spaceship blueprint record was being inscribed, there was no change in Valeria's expression.
"...as expected, I can't restore the blueprint. However, the year of production and the name of the creator appear, it was made in 1775, centered around a person named Tinggen Bower."
"Tinggen Bower?"
It was a name he had never heard before. The names of the other participants also came up, and they were all magic engineers affiliated with Gipl.
Valeria, who was reading the record of the mechanical device, looked surprised.
"Why is that?"
"This is the core component of the teleportation device you first saw in the Gaipa military road. Similarly, Tinggen Bower made it... wait, it's not his real name?"
Record magic cannot hide a human's pseudonym.
However, Valeria felt that a strange resistance was preventing Tinggen Bower's real name from being revealed.
This means that historical manipulation was also performed on the character of Tinggen Bower, and that Tinggen Bower could be a person related to Hister.
Valeria started to concentrate again. For some reason, she had a feeling that the real name would appear if she removed a bit of the resistance.
Her intuition was not wrong, and about 5 minutes later, Valeria was able to figure out what Tinggen Bower's real name was, sweating profusely.
<Creator: Kwaoul Ganesto (Tinggen Bower)>
Upon hearing that name, Jin had no choice but to open his eyes wide.
That's because he had seen a person with the surname 'Ganesto' in the record device of Solderet.
